{{Quote|Shantee Ren still lives on Mhatma 5, a cold frontier world with a large preserve of transplanted wild stohls.|Holobrochure for the Tagge Holographic Museum of Chandrila|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
'''Mhatma 5''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] that occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="Creatures" /> in the [[Mhatma system/Legends|Mhatma system]], a part of the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mhatma 5 was situated on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] frontier.<ref name="Creatures" />

At some point after the popular [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] celebrity [[Shantee Ren]] launched her [["Save the Stohl" campaign|campaign]] to have the [[stohl]]&mdash;elusive, [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[Snake/Legends|serpent]]-like [[Diet/Legends|predators]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="Creatures" /> the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]]<ref name="EAOC Ichtor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ichtor system/Legends|Ichtor system]]</ref> [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|76|Ichtor 8}}</ref> [[Ichtor 8]]&mdash;declared an endangered [[Species/Legends|species]], a large preserve of transplanted wild stohls was established on Mhatma 5. Ren herself also took up permanent residence on the world, and an entry of a [[Holo-brochure|holobrochure]] for the [[Tagge Holographic Museum]] of<ref name="Creatures" /> the planet<ref name="CSWE Chandrila">{{CSWECite|I|119|Chandrila}}</ref> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] dedicated to the stohl later noted that the holovid star still resided there.<ref name="Creatures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mhatma 5 was mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section of the book mentioning the planet was authored by [[Phil Brucato]].<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Mhatma [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Mhatma 5, in grid square I-16.<ref name="TEA" />
